MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  July 23, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:09 p.m. in Conference Room 4, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were
Chair Carbajal, Vice Chair Gomez, Commissioner Flores, and Commissioner Salas. Also,
present were Jesus Gomez, City Manager, Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst, and
Svetlana Hernandez, Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Flores motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International
Friendship Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on June 9, 2026. Vice
Chair Gomez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice  Chair  Gomez,  Commissioner  Flores,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Recap of Independence Day Festival Commission Booth

Ms. Bulosan presented the results of the survey conducted during the Independence Day
Festival event. The Commission was pleased with the results and engagement received
by the community. Commissioner Salas also shared her feedback on the conversations
she had with residents regarding potential Friendship/ Sister Cities that can be explored.

Friendship/Sister Cities Discussion

The Commission discussed the possibilities of potential Friendship Cities in Zacatecas,
Mexico. Vice Chair Gomez presented ideas for three potential Friendship Cities to explore
before committing to a sister city. The Commissioners also discussed programs and
possible partnerships through business that can be done with the three proposed cities
in Zacatecas and how their goods can benefit the City of Norwalk while promoting
economic development.
 STAFF COMMENTS

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:57 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
